notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
Thanks for taking time to purchase and review our first social genre, Virtual Reality game for the HTC Vive. 

Rota Craze was meant to be a straight forward game that anyone in the family could play. We wanted to keep the play mechanics simple and the challenge ever growing.

We are interested in your feedback. What would make the game play better in your eyes? Is there something you do not like? Let us know. We have a few ideas. But what you say matters the most!

Thank you sincerely for supporting our indie game development team!

We know this is not a block buster game. But we hope you enjoy it all the same.

The Scoles Technologies Team
